name: injection_v1.1
spec: injection_v1 (Scientist spec, 2026-11-10) re-run with the v1.1 code: same hosts, seeds and draws, plus the registered wrong-density subset (docs/v1.1_plan.md)

draws.t0: uniform within one period of the data start

model.limb_darkening: quadratic, Claret 2017 TESS at TIC Teff/logg

inject_into: normalised PDCSAP flux, all cadences, before quality masking, prewhitening and detrending

wrong_density.note: transit drawn from the true density (a/R* scales as rho^(1/3)); the search caps durations with the TIC density. Seed: sha256('v1.1-density:<sector>:<run>:<tic>').
